run_validate_json_cli: run the validate_json CLI to validate a dataset of parse trees against JSON schemas
create_JSONValidator: create a JSONValidator instance that loads schemas from a directory and resolves cross references
validate_data: validate JSON parse trees from a dataset file where each row has a command and parse tree separated by a pipe
validate_instance: validate a single parse tree dictionary against the loaded JSON schema and return a boolean result
review_JSONValidator_class: review the JSONValidator class and its schema loading, reference resolving, and validation methods
